creatures.name: Risaco
creatures.story: Nasce como um saquinho vivo; o riso faz sua membrana inflar e tombar.
creatures.identity: Corpo-rosto único de membrana ameixa/preta, nó ocre com abas-orelhas, crescente ocre e focinho creme.
creatures.tradeoff: Sem pernas desenvolvidas, depende de pequenos saltos e tombos.
creatures.review: Uma massa de corpo-rosto, duas pequenas pontas de pé, nó e duas abas auriculares assimétricas; rabiola curta com um terminal. Expressão inocente e simplicidade separadas dos outros estágios.
creatures.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Design ONE original BABY first-stage Soulmonster, RISACO, in the family of the supplied approved adult armored hyena. Reference image role: ONLY family palette, hyena ancestry and black-bag living-kite material, NOT adult anatomy or armor. Invent an extremely simple embryonic living tied garbage-paper pouch, NOT a miniature of the adult. Single soft squat rounded triangular black/plum bag-body merges with a small cream hyena muzzle, a little broad black nose, two small amber manga eyes and a cheeky laughing mouth with ONE tiny tooth. Two asymmetrical rounded folded ear tabs grow from the top of the pouch beside one ochre tie knot, clear hyena hint, no enormous fluffy mane. Body has ONE big flat ochre crescent patch integrated in the membrane, not stitched. Two tiny cream toe buds peep below the sack; no developed legs, no arms, no armor, no human clothing. ONE very short complete ochre cord rabiola from back ending in a single tiny torn black/teal paper pennant, fully attached, no disconnected flame creature. Slight tilt as if wobbling and giggling, innocent mischief rather than anger. The single pouch has simple volume, few compressed folds at tie and bottom, not a crumpled ball. 45% living creature,45% kite membrane/cord construction,10% manga crisp contour sensibility. Pure white background, full creature with generous margins, no lettering or extra studies, square composition. Clean original 2D manga cel character design, dark controlled ink contour, plum/charcoal, warm ochre, cream, small teal accent; flat matte color and just two hard shadow planes, no glossy rendering, no painterly noise, no 3D, no origami shards, no realistic trash. BABY MUCH SIMPLER than child, face/body one form, memorable lovable odd little living knot-pouch. Do not copy designs from other franchises.

creatures.name: Rasquim
creatures.story: Aprende a correr e recolher membranas; transforma a primeira camada num abrigo solto para ombros.
creatures.identity: Hiena compacta de quatro patas, uma orelha caída, gola preta aberta e crescentes ocres.
creatures.tradeoff: As abas soltas protegem pouco e ainda não contêm a energia.
creatures.review: Quatro membros identificáveis; uma pata dianteira levantada e três apoios. Cabeça e patas maiores em proporção, orelha caída e gola solta distinguem da anatomia adulta. Rabiola única com um terminal.
creatures.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new CHILD-stage Soulmonster RASQUIM in the supplied approved adult hyena's evolutionary family. Reference role only: family identity (plum, ochre, cream, charcoal membrane and teal accent), rounded hyena ears, mocking smile, sack material; adult armor and body must NOT be miniaturized. Create a lively knee-high HYENA PUP QUADRUPED, compact pear-shaped chest/body, short hindquarters, four stocky little legs and oversized clumsy forepaws, short broad muzzle, chunky young jaw, rounded ears one up one floppy, small mischievous amber manga eyes. Child proportions and playful alert personality, not adult aggression. Head differentiated from adult, no adult mane, a small three-point cream throat tuft only. He has turned one black living garbage-bag membrane into a loose HOODED SHOULDER RUFF / open bib: a tied rolled black collar behind neck, two broad loose flaps lie alongside forelegs, visibly soft and folded, no full chestplate or leg armor, body mostly exposed plum living kite paper with one ochre crescent on hip and cream belly. Bag's drawstring is integrated around the collar with one lopsided large ochre knot, no human clothes. Ear-tabs and bib made from same growing membranes as baby, body must read as living kite creature not real dog wearing a costume. One near forepaw raised about to pounce, other three feet support weight, four limb roots legible. A single complete short cord tail from rump ends in ONE black/ochre torn pennant with teal edge, one tiny teal wisp only at tip. Face toothy chuckle, visible jaw and a few small teeth, broad hyena black nose, not fox or wolf muzzle. 45% animal,45% living kite,10% selective stepped outline 2D manga. Pure white background, full body and all extremities inside with generous safe margins, landscape. Clean expressive 2D manga monster concept, dark precise linework and crisp solid color, two hard cel-shadow values, no 3D, no glossy painted gradients, no realistic fur, no allover origami folds, no busy ornaments or recycling symbols. No weapons, no wings, no extra limbs, no text. Strong unique child silhouette, NOT adult shrunk down.

creatures.name: Rasgargal
creatures.story: Comprime as membranas num reservatório assimétrico; o riso acumula pressão que escapa pelo primeiro rasgo.
creatures.identity: Hiena esguia com ombro alto, quadril estreito, uma grande ombreira atada e um antebraço protegido.
creatures.tradeoff: A descarga descontrolada desequilibra sua distribuição de força.
creatures.review: Quatro patas, cintura recolhida e antebraços alongados. Ombreira grande de um lado e proteção pequena do outro, só uma greva pesada; não repete couraça adulta. Uma emissão de chama principal no ombro e rabiola de dois terminais.
creatures.prompt:
Use case stylized-concept. Create ONE original YOUNG / adolescent-stage Soulmonster RASGARGAL, pre-evolution of supplied approved adult Ressonhiena. Input role: author's family identity and clean cel-shaded style only. Invent a STRONGLY DIFFERENT adolescent body, not adult minus a few armor plates. Rangy feral scavenger HYENA quadruped with very high narrow shoulders, long powerful forearms, long sloping back descending to small angular hips, tucked-up belly, long lower legs and four distinct dark clawed paws. Head smaller relative to torso than child's, long broad-jawed hyena muzzle, small keen amber eyes, two rounded upright ears, a sly uneven toothy laugh. Plum body with ochre angled cheek and flank crescents, cream short bristling paper mane runs only from neck down upper spine. Thin body has tension and directional midscale paper tufts, not exposed realistic ribs.

BLACK GARBAGE-BAG MATTER is developing a new function: ONE huge inflated tied sack pauldron envelops the NEAR shoulder, stretched black membrane bearing an ochre pull-cord knot at top, a single green-teal spectral flame jet escaping a diagonal tear. Other shoulder has only a small folded layered black membrane cap: obvious asymmetry. ONE foreleg has a thick rolled cuff of pressed black folded layers, other foreleg exposed plum with cream wrist tufts. Neck has loose ochre/charcoal pressure folds, NO mature full cuirass, no adult helmet, no full leg armor. On rear hips a loose short ragged black paper fold begins to cinch, not full armor skirt. Material is integrated living kite membranes, not real garbage props hung on a dog. A SINGLE connected long black braided rabiola from rump ends in two ragged ochre/black pennants with teal edges, swept low behind. All cords attached, one soul.

Pose actively stalking at a three-quarter diagonal, head low, shoulder braced, near forepaw extended planted, other three feet visible with coherent roots and joints. Emphasize imbalance and growing power rather than bulky adult strength. Flame appears ONLY from the large shoulder tear, flows backward above back, does not obscure ears or legs. No floating trash or tools, no metal costume. 45% living creature,45% kite/sack construction,10% crisp 2D manga selectively stepped ink edges. Pure white landscape canvas, full body and tail with generous margins, no lettering. Dark confident linework, flat plum/ochre/cream/charcoal palette, restrained cyan-green bright accent, 2-3 hard cel shadow values. No painterly texture, glossy 3D, hyperreal plastic, dense crumpled origami, hundreds of spikes or borrowed franchise armor. Keep young much lankier, rougher and less armored than adult.
